description: This file defines an abstract base class 'NormalizerBase' for normalizers in Drupal's serialization module, implementing support checks for normalization and denormalization, format support, cache dependency addition, and supported types.

classes.name: NormalizerBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for normalizers, providing common functionality for normalization and denormalization support, format checking, and cache dependency management.

methods.name: supportsNormalization
methods.description: Checks if the data can be normalized by this normalizer based on object type and format.

methods.name: supportsDenormalization
methods.description: Checks if the data can be denormalized to the specified type and format.

methods.name: checkFormat
methods.description: Determines if the given format is supported, with special handling for 'json_schema'.

methods.name: addCacheableDependency
methods.description: Adds cacheability information to the context if the data supports it.

methods.name: getSupportedTypes
methods.description: Returns an array of supported types for normalization, defaulting to all types unsupported.
